title: Making a WoW style raid boss simulator roguelike
author: Fusionism
selftext:
[Wow boss raider test](https://talismanlabs.vercel.app/bossraider.html)

There's a link where you can try it out. It's pretty rough so far as I'm still working on the core systems.

I always had fun raiding in wow optimizing my dps and rotations, any ideas on how to lean into this mechanic? Also I'm thinking of making it a roguelike where in addition to the current randomly generated gear you'll be able to select one of 3 randomly generated spells to add to your spells so you can sort of go towards a certain build, you can go for fire, or poison damage, or anything else, I'm going to add tons of synergies and buffs and debuffs, in addition to spells that can buff your raid damage as well.

If I really get ambitious I'll add a way to play as a healer or tank as well.
